artworks.title: Bloody hands
artworks.description:
There is no holy water strong enough to wash away the blood on your ballot.

Não existe água benta que limpe o sangue do seu voto.

artworks.title: Sunday Rituals, Saturday Sins
artworks.description:
There is no meaning in praying at church on Sundays while preaching hate on Saturdays.

Não adianta ir a igreja aos domingos e pregar o ódio aos sábados.

artworks.title: The Sanctity of Desire
artworks.description: Caught between the weight of devotion and the vulnerability of the flesh, a holy symbol gently shields the naked form. Here, sacred architecture meets raw human truth, creating a quiet sanctuary where dogma and desire softly intertwine.

artworks.title: Sensual Submission
artworks.description: Within the blur, a delicate tension hangs in the air, a soft yet intense moment where anticipation fills the frame and raw intimacy awaits.

artworks.title: Desecrated Communion
artworks.description: Eyes veiled in black, she parts her lips for the ultimate profane ritual. It is not bread or wine but a hand offering the raw essence of transgression. Here, desire, sin, and lust unite to nourish a dark and binding covenant.

artworks.title: Svetlanna
artworks.description: Svetlanna (also known as lil' russa) is a Brazilian digital creator, model, OF creator, and prominent sex worker rights activist
